name: Bosscat Kitchen & Libations
tagline: Upscale Southern comfort, 300+ whiskeys & famous weekend brunch
description: Located in a restored historic brick building on West Chapman Avenue, Bosscat Kitchen & Libations delivers hearty American comfort fare with an upscale twist. Famous for its glass-enclosed Whiskey Room showcasing over 300 bottles, inventive cocktails, lively weekend brunch, and everyday happy hour with savory sliders and Southern bites.
historicNote: Housed in one of West Chapman's prime historic commercial spaces with exposed brick walls, vintage industrial steel, and reclaimed timber.

specials.title: Everyday Happy Hour: $6 Drafts & $8 Sliders
specials.description: $6 draft beers, $7 well spirits, $8 house cocktails, and $7-$8 sliders and fried pickles.

specials.title: Bourbon & Bites Afternoon
specials.description: $9 House Old Fashioneds, $8 Moscow Mules, and $6 Grilled Cheese bites in the whiskey room.

specials.title: Midweek Whiskey & Wings
specials.description: $8 Spicy Chicken Wings, Korean fried chicken sliders, and $6 local draft craft beers.

specials.title: Thursday Social Hour
specials.description: Featured whiskey pours, $8 house wines, and $8 short rib grilled cheese appetizers.

specials.title: Friday Kickoff Happy Hour
specials.description: Start the weekend with $6 draft pours, $9 craft cocktails, and savory bar snacks until 6 PM.

specials.title: Weekend Southern Brunch Club
specials.description: Famous chicken and waffles, French toast bites, breakfast burgers, and craft brunch cocktails.

specials.title: Sunday Brunch & Afternoon Happy Hour
specials.description: Southern brunch menu from 10 AM to 2 PM, followed by 3 PM to 6 PM Happy Hour drink specials.

events.title: Wednesday Whiskey Room Tasting Flights
